spec.assertion: it.skip — no trigger primitive for 'self status ends'; nearest expressible (burstCast) fires 10s early, mistiming the ammo dump and Heat Emission onset.

consumeAmmo fraction 1 on the trigger block; forces an immediate reload (fires lastBullet). Covered indirectly by the reload-penalty damage test — a missing dump leaves the magazine full and skips the forced reload.

Asserts reloadSpeedPct is applied to grave with a NEGATIVE value (-50). Fails under the nearest-wrong 'defensive, skip' drop AND under a sign-flip: the counterfactual patching value to +50 must strictly INCREASE her damage, proving reload ratio gates shots fired.

Asserts a heal effect exists and that stripping it moves some unit's total — proving it emits recovery events for a teammate's on-recovery trigger (crown in controlComp) rather than being dropped as 'defensive'.

burstGenPct 38.96 lands on >1 targetSlug INCLUDING grave ('all allies' includes self). Non-vacuity: removing it must not increase Full Burst count over 180s, proving the buff is wired to rotation cadence, not a dead stat row.
pierceDamagePct 48.4 on multiple targetSlugs. Fails under a self-only target-set misread. Value-discriminated from the two burst pierce lines (52.8 self / 39.98 allies).
Overheat I atkPct 15.48 first applies at frame > 0, which a passive/interval mis-encoding (live at t=0) cannot satisfy.

spec.kitLine: Removed upon reloading to max ammo
spec.assertion: Asserts a buffRemove with cause 'reload' exists on grave (the engine emits buffRemove ONLY for removeOnReload). Counterfactual replacing removeOnReload with durationSec:999 must strictly increase damage — the nearest-wrong 'permanent buff' reading.
atkPct 20.66 on grave only. Paired with the ordering test: its first apply frame > 0 (30-attack gate), never t=0.

Asserts stat is attackDamagePct (additive Damage-Up bucket) and NOT atkPct at 30.8. Counterfactual re-stating it to atkPct must change the total — the buckets cannot coincide with liter/crown/helm buffs diluting the Damage-Up sum. This is the single highest-value bucket discrimination in the kit.
Overheat III's first apply frame >= Overheat II's, and Overheat II's > 0 — proving the escalation ordering is real. Plus a target-set inertness sweep: no ally ever receives 15.48/20.66/30.8.
it.skip — v1 models no HP pool (immortal boss); self-drain is unobservable and offensively inert.
Two-sided: removing unlimitedAmmo must LOWER damage (it is load-bearing), and stretching durationSec to 180 must RAISE it (proving the 10s bound is enforced, not a whole-fight window).

Encoded as a gainPierce EFFECT with durationSec 10, not the static hasPierce flag. Two counterfactuals: setting hasPierce:true must raise damage (proving the committed file does NOT whole-fight-tag her), and deleting durationSec must raise damage (proving the timed bound is live). This is the gainPierce-vs-hasPierce trap.
pierceDamagePct 52.8 lands on grave and ONLY grave ('Affects self' block), distinguishing it from the 39.98% all-allies line in the second burst block.

Read via targetSlug-filtered events so helm's own critRateNormalPct line cannot confound it.
attackDamagePct 48.2 reaches >1 slug INCLUDING grave (all-allies includes self, no excludeSelf). Counterfactual re-stating it to atkPct must change the total — bucket discrimination.
pierceDamagePct 39.98 on >1 targetSlug, value-separated from the 52.8 self line and the 48.4 skill1 line.

Asserts maxAmmoFlat 3 exists and NO maxAmmoPct at 3 — the '3 round(s)' → '3 percent' misread is the nearest-wrong. Non-vacuity: stripping maxAmmoFlat must move at least one unit's total, proving the +3 rounds reaches the team's shot economy.
it.skip — the removal conditions are literally unstated in the prose, so Heat Emission uptime cannot be bounded from the kit alone. ⚑ Any uptime number is an estimate requiring footage.

spec.kitLine: only when in Heat Emission status
spec.assertion: it.skip — the schema's only status gate (requiresTargetStatus) is boss-scoped; there is no self-status gate, so the heal / gauge / pierce blocks can only be approximated as passives, which over-credits them before the first Prediction ends.

fixtures: controlComp('grave', true) throughout — liter B1 / crown B2 / grave carry / helm B3, Fire boss, focus grave. grave is Burst II, so the control comp's other tiers are REQUIRED for a Full Burst chain to complete and for her burst to cast at all (a lone unit makes ZERO Full Bursts, and every burst-slot line here would be vacuous). helm=true is kept even for the crit test because that test reads grave's OWN buffApply events filtered by targetSlug+stat rather than team totals, which is immune to helm's critRateNormalPct line; keeping helm also preserves crown as a live consumer of grave's Heat-Emission heal (the recovery-trigger tandem check). One baseline run is hoisted and shared; each counterfactual is one additional runComp, ~13 runs total.
gaps: skill1 trigger 'Activates when Prediction status ends' — no self-status-end trigger primitive; nearest key (burstCast) fires 10 s early.
'Removes Heat Emission under certain conditions' — conditions unstated in the prose; Heat Emission uptime is unbounded/measurement-gated (⚑).
Heat-Emission-gated blocks — no self-status block gate in the schema (requiresTargetStatus is boss-only); modeled as passives, which over-credits the pre-first-burst window.
burst 'Current HP ▼1% every 1 sec' — no HP pool in v1 (immortal boss); unobservable and offensively inert.
skill2 'attacks landed' vs rounds-fired: coincide with no miss model, but the 30/60 tiers are additionally gated on Prediction being active, and that gate is not expressible.
